claim: Sellers active on two or more marketplaces averaged 17.5 times the GMV of sellers on a single marketplace ($10.07m vs $575,093).

claim: Sellers using Mirakl's AI catalogue tool to classify products and standardise listings across marketplaces generated 88% higher GMV than those who did not (vendor-reported).
source: Mirakl, The marketplace revolution: Key insights from our 2026 Seller Report

claim: Australians spent $18.9 billion on pure online marketplaces in 2025, up 13% year on year and 23% of all online spending.

source: Australia Post, Category Insights: Online marketplaces (eCommerce Report 2026)

claim: 73% of Australian online shoppers made a purchase on a marketplace in 2025.
source: Australia Post, Category Insights: Online marketplaces (eCommerce Report 2026)

claim: 73% of Australian shoppers say a good delivery experience makes them more likely to shop online.

claim: Inventory distortion (out-of-stocks plus overstocks) costs retailers an estimated $1.73 trillion a year, 6.5% of global retail sales.
